name: Bikaji Foods International Limited
summary: Bikaji Foods International Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures, purchases, and sells snack food products in India and internationally. It offers sweets, pellets, bhujia, namkeen, papad, chips, and other snacks, as well as frozen food products, gift packs, mathris, and cookies under the Bikaji brand. The company sells its products through general trade, supermarkets, hypermarkets, convenience stores and mini markets, wholesalers, and distributors, as well as online channels.
